parts.label: Cell wall
parts.note: A stiff outer layer of cellulose that holds the shape

parts.label: Cell membrane
parts.note: Just inside the wall: controls what goes in and out

parts.label: Vacuole
parts.note: A big sac of watery sap that keeps the cell firm

parts.label: Nucleus
parts.note: The control centre: holds the DNA

parts.label: Cytoplasm
parts.note: Jelly where the cell does its work
